name: Hdmi Cec → Send
description: Queues a message for transmission. Up to four messages wait in the queue while the bus is busy. A message is sent bit by bit from the main loop, which takes about 25 ms per byte, so the loop pauses for up to 400 ms while a message goes out; a warning about a slow operation during a send is expected.

config_entries.label: Data
config_entries.description: The payload, the opcode first, up to 15 bytes. A lambda returns a `std::vector<uint8_t>`.

config_entries.label: Destination
config_entries.description: The logical address to send to, `0xF` for a broadcast.
